title: Object pool
summary: No allocations in the middle of a frame.

cards.title: Why pool?
cards.body:
A shooter may create and destroy hundreds of bullets per second. Calling `new`/`delete` that often costs time, can cause unpredictable spikes, and fragments memory.

An **object pool** allocates all objects once and recycles them.
The free slots form a linked list stored inside the pool's own array: a linked list with zero allocations.

cards.question: Why are acquire() and release() O(1)?
choices: They search for a free slot
They only touch the head of the free list
cards.explain: Taking or returning a slot is a push/pop on the front of a linked list: a couple of assignments, no searching.
